audit.whatIsWrong: Level-chart stages carried a closing verdict that contradicted the stage owner (for example a stage marked Graves ending "Camille is favoured here").
audit.why: The full-layer phase text was templated; the tail sentence was never reconciled with phases[].side, so the written verdict and the chart disagreed on the same page.
audit.corrected: Each phase why now closes with the verdict that matches its own side field, so early / mid / side-lane ownership reads consistently.

audit.why: Spike stages line up with the real kits: Camille at 2 (Hookshot, 16s at rank 1), 6 (The Hextech Ultimatum, 140s at rank 1) and her Sheen item; Graves at Collateral Damage (100/80/60).

audit.whatIsWrong: The Level 6 stage told you to "use the cast's brief untargetable frame" on The Hextech Ultimatum to dodge Graves's key spell.
audit.why: Riot's own description of The Hextech Ultimatum is "Camille dashes to target champion, anchoring them to the area" — there is no untargetable window. The kit file's untargetable/channel flags on R are tooltip-parse misfires and contradict the description.
audit.corrected: The stage now says the dash grants no immunity and keys R to being spent after the enemy spell rather than into it.

edits.before: The Hextech Ultimatum (R) isolates a target in a 1v1 they cannot leave. Use the cast's brief untargetable frame to dodge Graves's Quickdraw or burst, then focus the trapped target. Graves is favoured here.
edits.after: The Hextech Ultimatum (R) isolates a target in a 1v1 they cannot leave. The dash grants no immunity, so spend R once Graves's Quickdraw is gone, not into it, then focus the trapped target. Graves is favoured here.

edits.before: Graves owns level 1 — his two-shot auto burst plus Buckshot (Q) out-damages your single Q, and your Adaptive Defense shield only soaks one hit, so never contest that first trade; keep the shield up and farm. The lane flips at level 2-3: with Q's empowered re-cast (the second hit's bonus true damage) and a point in E, you grapple in, W-slow him so he can't kite, and land both Q hits before his autos reload. Bait his Smoke Screen (W) first — once that blind and slow are on cooldown your autos and Q sail clean through.
edits.after: Graves owns level 1 — his two-shot auto burst plus Buckshot (Q) out-damages your single Q, and your Adaptive Defenses shield only soaks one hit, so never contest that first trade; keep the shield up and farm. The lane flips at level 2-3: with Q's empowered re-cast (the second hit's bonus true damage) and a point in E, you grapple in, W-slow him so he can't kite, and land both Q hits before his autos reload. Bait his Smoke Screen (W) first — once that blind and slow are on cooldown your autos and Q sail clean through.

notes: Camille kit file flags R as channel/interruptible and untargetable; both contradict Riot's own description (a dash plus an anchoring zone) and were treated as tooltip-parse misfires, per the kit README. Packet win rate 52.71% over 1474 games.
